speaker: Patient

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

The onset of gait and limb ataxia in a patient with Crohn's disease recently treated with natalizumab is a classic presentation of PML. I will wait for the MRI results to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of white matter lesions.
